subject: SKU split shipment & customs holdback — cloud backstop plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: John Sanchez <john.sanchez@omni-oem.com>, cloudsales@majorcloud.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Capacity ask for ACME-4521 — possible split shipments?

John / Cloud team —

We just turned the corner in commercial with Acme (deal ACME-4521). They want a dedicated capacity window tied to milestones: 120 A100-class GPUs provisioned for a dedicated pool. The commercial ask is tight — 50% live within 60 days of PO and remainder within 120 days.

Two procurement risks we need to address up front:
- OEM lead time: Acme's procurement requires a firm ETA and partial-shipment option (they prefer a two-tranche delivery to help with customs and rack space).
- Customs hold / broker delays: Acme operates in multiple US ports; if units get held, the onboarding schedule slips.

Options I'm exploring:
1) OEM partial shipment (ship 60 units immediately, remainder on 60-day cadence) with a customs holdback clause that allows us to stage remaining inventory in an OMNI bonded facility.
2) Major Cloud reserved instances (short-term reservation) as a backstop for the first 60 days while physical kit clears customs. Cloud team — can you confirm reservation lead time and whether we can attach a credit for usage while OEM kit is in-transit?

John — please share SKU/MPN lead times and whether OMNI will agree to a split-ship PO with part numbers and serial assignment before final shipment. Also include freight and customs pro-forma (we'll need ETA windows, HS codes, and incoterms).

I attached the Acme onboarding milestone grid to illustrate the timing.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme-shipping-pro-forma.xlsx
From: John Sanchez <john.sanchez@omni-oem.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: leasing@logisticsco.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 15:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Capacity ask for ACME-4521 — possible split shipments?

Mina —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: split shipments are possible; OMNI can do a staged delivery for the quoted SKUs but there are a few caveats.

Details:
- SKUs/MPNs: OMNI-A100-80GB (MPN: OMN-A100-80G-1), OMNI-RACK-KIT (rack rails + PDUs). Lead time for full build: 14–18 weeks from PO for full quantity. Partial build / prioritization can move the first tranche to ~8–10 weeks if we prioritize the batch run.
- Partial shipments: We can issue a split-PO and mark serials for tranche 1. Legal wants a 30% deposit at PO to start wafer allocation for prioritized manufacturing.
- Customs/bonded staging: OMNI has a bonded consolidation facility in NJ and a transit hub in Savannah. We can land units at the bonded facility and release inventory to Redwood/Acme on formal customs clearance. This adds ~3–7 business days handling plus potential port congestion variance.
- Freight/incoterms: CIF to our bonded facility or DDP to Acme's DC (your preference). Freight quote included in the attached OMNI quote PDF.

Attachments: OMNI-quote-2028-02-10.pdf

If you want, I can propose a tranche schedule aligned to your 60/120 day milestones and mark a portion of production as expedited.

Best,
John Sanchez
Enterprise Accounts — OMNI OEM
john.sanchez@omni-oem.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: John Sanchez <john.sanchez@omni-oem.com>, cloudsales@majorcloud.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 11:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Capacity ask for ACME-4521 — tranche schedule and deposit

John — thanks, that helps. A few follow-ups:

1) Tranche schedule: please propose exact ship-by windows for tranche 1 and tranche 2 (we need hard dates to commit to Acme). Make sure serials for tranche 1 are available to provide to Acme for validation.
2) Deposit: Acme prefers a two-stage deposit (10% to lock schedule, additional 20% on build start). Would OMNI accept that split?
3) Customs-controlled release: If units are staged at your NJ bonded facility, we need a SLA for release once customs clears — SLA target = 3 business days for outbound release on receipt of customs docs.

Cloud team — Ben / Cloud sales: can you confirm whether Major Cloud can offer an on-demand reserved pool for up to 60 GPUs inside the US-east region with immediate activation (within 48 hours) and whether Redwood can exchange that reserved usage for OEM-hours credit once kit is live? We're expecting the cloud backstop to be short-term (30–60 days max) but it needs to be low-friction for Acme's engineering ramp.

If we can get OMNI to accept the deposit split and a release SLA, we'll present the combined plan to Acme as the commercial fallback.

Thanks,
Mina

From: Major Cloud Sales <cloudsales@majorcloud.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 17:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Capacity ask for ACME-4521 — tranche schedule and deposit

Mina / Ben —

We can stand up a reserved on-demand pool in us-east-1 for 60 GPUs within 48 hours of contract signature. Terms: 7–30 day minimum billing depending on instance family; we can offer a credit equal to up to 50% of the reservation spend if OEM hardware is delivered and validated within 90 days, crediting against your future reserved commitment.

Important operational notes:
- Instance parity: we can match the A100-like profile but performance varies slightly by host; we will provide benchmark numbers and a short trial window for Acme (48–72 hours).
- Networking: dedicated VPC peering and private link can be provisioned in parallel; allow 24–48 hours for networking configs.
- Billing: we issue a prepay invoice for the first 30 days; credit applied after OEM confirmation.

Attached: majorcloud-reservation-term-sheet.pdf

Let me know if you want a short SOW and we'll draft a one-page addendum that codifies the credit and activation timeline.

Regards,
Major Cloud Sales
cloudsales@majorcloud.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: John Sanchez <john.sanchez@omni-oem.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 13:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Capacity ask for ACME-4521 — commercial tradeoffs and contract note

Quick note on commercial parameters:
- Cost: expedited partial-build + bonded staging + freight will add ~8–12% on OEM quote. The cloud backstop adds an additional 30 days of billable reservation costs (~market rate), mostly offset by the 50% credit John/Cloud proposed.
- Contract: Legal will accept a split deposit but asks we put a clear release trigger (customs docs + serial reconciliation) for tranche payment. Also recommend a delivery SLA credit: 0.5% of monthly fees per week late beyond the committed tranche window, capped at 6%.
- Internal ask: Can we lock the PoC/acceptance criteria (benchmarks and KV latency targets) as the condition to swap out cloud capacity for OEM hardware credits?

If OMNI can sign the split-PO with the 10%/20% deposit schedule and commit to a 3-business-day bonded release, I think commercial can accept the attached cost delta and present to Acme tomorrow.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: John Sanchez <john.sanchez@omni-oem.com>, cloudsales@majorcloud.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ops@acme-ai.com
Date: Mon, 21 Feb 2028 15:40:00 -0000
Subject: Final: conditional 60/120 tranche plan + cloud backstop (next steps)

Team —

Thanks for the quick turns. Convergence summary and required sign-offs so we can present to Acme this week: 

1) Tranche plan
- Tranche 1: 60 OMNI-A100-80GB to be produced and shipped to OMNI NJ bonded facility; target ship-by: 2028-04-01 – 2028-04-08 (expedited run). Serial list to be provided 5 business days before outbound.
- Tranche 2: remaining 60 units — ship-by window target 2028-06-01 – 2028-06-15.

2) Deposits / PO
- Redwood/Acme to issue split-PO (10% lock / 20% on build start). John to confirm OMNI acceptance by EOD 22 Feb.

3) Bonded release SLA
- OMNI to commit to outbound release within 3 business days of receiving customs clearance docs. OMNI confirmable by providing broker tracking and outbound AWB.

4) Cloud backstop
- Major Cloud to provision 60-GPU reserved pool in us-east-1 within 48 hours of SOW signature. Prepay invoice for first 30 days; 50% credit applied if OEM hardware delivered and validated within 90 days. Activation threshold: if tranche 1 is delayed >7 calendar days beyond the ship-by window, Redwood to trigger cloud allocation for Acme.

5) Acceptance swap criteria
- Swap from cloud backstop to OEM credits requires: hardware serial reconciliation + acceptance bench (latency P95 < X ms on Acme prompt set) + confirmation from Acme ops.

Next steps (owners):
- John Sanchez (OMNI): confirm split-PO acceptance and deposit split + attach updated quote with expedited lead times (due EOD 22 Feb).
- Major Cloud Sales: draft one-page SOW with credit terms (due EOD 22 Feb).
- Ben/Legal: draft contract addendum with delivery credit language and acceptance swap criteria (Ben/Legal to circulate by 23 Feb).

If everyone confirms, I'll book a 30-min alignment call with Acme for Wed 23 Feb to present the fallback and commercial impact.

Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: OMNI-quote-2028-02-10.pdf, majorcloud-reservation-term-sheet.pdf, acme-shipping-pro-forma.xlsx
